description: Quote a live Relay route from an EVM source asset into Base USDC. The response contains unsigned transaction data; this tool never signs or submits it.

amount.description: Source amount in the source token’s base units

recipient.description: Base recipient; defaults to the source wallet

sourceCurrency.description: Source token address or native currency identifier

tradeType.description: Relay amount mode; defaults to EXACT_INPUT

name: peer_cash_quote_source
title: Quote a source asset into Base USDC
